annotations.title: Reactions a compound or protein takes part in (inferred)

description: Lists the biochemical reactions from Rhea and Human-GEM that a compound is a substrate or product of, or that a protein (enzyme) catalyses or transports, by node id from search_nodes. It lists reactions and does not answer a route question: for "can X become Y" or "what can X become", use reach. Every row is assertion_class 'inferred': a reaction two public databases record, not a result anyone measured in a person. Present these as known biochemistry, never as an effect a compound has, and never as a recommendation. For effects, use find_evidence. Returns total and up to limit reactions (default 10), each with its equation, its participants by side, id and label, the first five enzymes with catalyst_count for all of them, and its source; offset pages the rest, and the default is enough to answer. A page too large for one result is cut to fit, and truncated with next_offset says how to get the rest. A compound flagged is_hub (water, ATP, protons and the like) returns its reaction count only, because it takes part in nearly every reaction. Coverage is one Rhea release and one Human-GEM release; a participant that is not a node in this graph is listed with a null id, and only human enzymes that are nodes are listed. An empty result means no reaction in those releases names this node. That is a complete answer and does not show the body has none.

limit.description: Reactions to return (1 to 50). Each carries its participants and enzymes; the default is enough to answer.

node_id.description: A node id in the form PREFIX:local, e.g. CHEBI:16919 (creatine). Get it from the id field of a search_nodes hit.

offset.description: Reactions to skip, to page past limit.
